title: Ziton Moj
subtitle: Sowing Chaos
text:
Ambush (When you play this unit, he may attack an enemy unit.)
On Attack: For each player, deal 1 damage to a unit that player controls.
rules:
Ambush is an ability that triggers at the same time as “When Played” abilities. The unit does not have to be ready in order to attack.
All damage dealt by Ziton's "On Attack" ability is dealt simultaneously.
